title: DPD-1.2 — Browser And Refresh Follow-Through Evidence
summary: record the exact Delete public-impact copy, Publish exclusion terminology, unchanged refresh ownership, focused browser checks, and DPD-1.3 stop gate
content_html:
DPD-1.2 — Browser And Refresh Follow-Through Evidence

Result

DPD-1.2 is complete. Existing parent and child Delete confirmations now state exact immediate public-projection impact when the server preview reports one. Successful Delete shows the same receipt-derived outcome. Publish now presents and enables its existing confirmation from excluded_count only. DPD-1.3 verification and durable-contract transfer have not started.

Delivered Browser Contract

  • One shared formatter reads only public_cleanup.applicable, exact projected_doc_ids, and exact removed_urls. It adds no public copy for local or already-unprojected deletion.
  • Parent selection Delete keeps exact checked IDs, descendant planning, current confirmation modal, cancel focus, fallback selection, configuration reload, and Index refresh. Its public completion text is applied after that existing refresh.
  • Sub-scope detail Delete keeps exact {scope, sub_scope, doc_id}, revision receipt, existing modal lifecycle, and committed-document reconciliation. Its confirmation and surviving completion surface use the shared formatter.
  • Publish confirmation says Files removed by current Publish exclusions and uses only excluded_count for both the count and enabled state. The retired removed_count field and stale-file terminology have no browser meaning.
  • No button, action definition, selection owner, per-document Publish or Unpublish control, public-file browser, or second deletion path was added.

Focused Verification

  • $HOME/miniconda3/bin/python3 docs-viewer/tests/smoke/docs_viewer_subscope_report_modules.py --site-root . — passed; covers exact child confirmation, cancel focus, modal lifecycle, apply receipt, committed-document reconciliation, and public completion copy.
  • With .env.local loaded, $HOME/miniconda3/bin/python3 docs-viewer/tests/smoke/docs_viewer_service_manage.py — passed; covers parent fallback behavior, public and local Delete formatting, duplicate-safe receipt counts, Publish exclusion copy, and rejection of the retired removal alias.
  • bin/lint-js across the three changed management modules — passed.
  • $HOME/miniconda3/bin/python3 -m py_compile across the two changed smoke files — passed.
  • Explicit Studio Docs and search writes were no-ops after the live projection: 282 documents, zero document/index writes or removals, zero warnings, and zero search writes.
  • Generated assertions confirmed the evidence document's exact ID, parent, done status, one tree placement, one Recent entry, and one search entry.
  • git diff --check — passed after code and generated-evidence updates.

Bounded Diff Review

The browser diff changes only the existing Delete copy seam, the existing Publish confirmation seam, and focused assertions. Review confirmed that parent fallback reload still selects the first surviving loadable root, default-document configuration reload remains conditional, child reconciliation still follows a validated apply receipt, and all busy, focus, cancel, error, and modal-destroy behavior is retained. There is no publication inference, public mutation, additional refresh, scope-wide Publish call, new control, or compatibility fallback to delayed-Delete fields.

Stop before DPD-1.3 verification and durable-contract transfer approval.
